- definition={wrapped} where wrapDefinition() is called EXACTLY ONCE (at load) — afterwards always store the instance onDefinitionChange emits (re-wrapping causes reload loops).
- onDefinitionChange: setWrapped(next) + schedule debounced save (~1.5s trailing; skip when JSON equals lastSavedJsonRef; flush on unmount; save regardless of validity).

- toolboxConfiguration: one group, three StepDefinition seeds — { componentType: 'task', type: 'prompt'|'image'|'video', name, properties } (memoized). stepsConfiguration = { iconUrlProvider }. validatorConfiguration: prompt → text non-empty; gen → values.prompt non-empty. controlBar, contextMenu, keyboard, undoStackSize={20}, theme="dark", isEditorCollapsed local state (default open). - CSS: import sequential-workflow-designer/css/designer.css + designer-dark.css + ./notebook.css; overrides scoped under a .vc-notebook wrapper — emerald plan-domain accents (src/theme/domains.ts), mono step labels, transparent canvas.

## C4. Canvas thumbnails + status (useCanvasStepDecorations)

Effect over rootRef.current.querySelectorAll('g[data-step-id]') (attribute verified in SWD 0.40.0): for each gen step's latest asset in mediaItems — ready → set the step <image> href to thumbnailSrc (same-origin /files/...?v= URLs, cache-bust free); pending/working → vc-step-running pulse class; error → vc-step-error. This is the one sanctioned imperative-DOM-via-refs effect; isolated so a future SWD upgrade only breaks this file (icons degrade to static).

## C5. Step editor (NotebookStepEditor) — compose, don't embed GenPreviewPanel

GenPreviewPanel (~1,240 lines) is rejected for reuse: per-category localStorage persistence, internal form state with no outward emission, full-panel chrome that can't fit the editor rail. Everything reusable is already extracted — compose from: ModelProviderSelector (gen/ui/ModelSelector.tsx), MediaStrip + media-strip.ts helpers, DynamicField, PromptSection, GenerateCommandButton + useEstimateCost, CharacterPickerPopover, and the whole mode engine gen/modes.ts (verbatim reuse: inferModeKey, filterValuesForMode, effectiveToolName, modeRequiredMissing, modeBudgetWarnings).

- Dispatch on useStepEditor().type. Prompt step → name input (setName) + textarea bound to properties.text.
- Gen step → useGenPreview(callTool, projectSlug, category=type, initial={model, provider}); every field change goes through one helper: setProperty('values', {...values, [k]: v}); notifyPropertiesChanged() → designer emits change → debounced save. Model/provider are separate properties; on re-open, merge saved values over the preview's prefilled_values.
- "Earlier outputs" row: thumbnails of prior steps' ready outputs; click → appendImageSlug/routeDrop into values. Prior outputs are ordinary img-*/vid-* assets, so @slug values work unchanged.
- "Use prompt from step above" chip (gen step with empty prompt + a prompt step above): COPIES nearestPromptAbove().text into values.prompt — copy, not live-binding, so the record stays accurate.
- Output gallery: one thumb per asset_ids entry with status ring (lookup in mediaItems; pending → spinner, error → failedMessage); click → onOpenAsset(id).
- Editor deps passed as explicit element props (stepEditor={<NotebookStepEditor callTool={...} .../>}); fall back to a small context only if the wrapper drops props (confirm at install).
- Skipped in v1 (deliberate): prompt-rewrite popover, JSON payload flip view, element groups.

## C6. Run flow (useNotebookRun)

Mirrors GenPreviewPanel.handleGenerate (838–923): (1) filterValuesForMode + effectiveToolName from modes.ts; (2) lifecycle 'started' event (createGenerationRequestId) so HomePage ghost tiles keep working; (3) await callTool(toolName, { ...submitValues, project_slug, _provider }), parse { img_asset_id | vid_asset_id }; (4) on success: clone definition, push id onto the step's asset_ids, controller.replaceDefinition(patched) → auto-saves; lifecycle 'submitted'; on error: lifecycle 'failed' + inline editor error. (5) STATUS IS FREE: HomePage's existing 5s sync → list_assets → mediaItems polling; pure stepRunStatus(step, mediaItems) powers the editor pill, Run-button disable while pending/working, and canvas decorations. No new polling, no tool calls in effects.

## C7. Wiring

CenterStage plan branch + HomePage planEmptyOverride branch both render PlanNotebook; pass onOpenAsset={handleOpenAsset}. Header /plan icon → NotebookPen.

title: Refactor: delete formula system, rebuild /plan as SWD notebook workflow
description:
Approved plan (2026-07-10): delete the "formula" system and rebuild /plan as a notebook workflow. Full plan file: ~/.claude/plans/lets-plan-a-big-wiggly-badger.md (sections mirrored into the child tasks of this epic).

## Context

The "formula" system (the /templates marketplace + three plan formulas: Char Swap, Storyboard, Clip Show, plus ~22 formula-specific MCP tools, jobs, and slash commands) is being fully removed. /plan is rebuilt as a Jupyter-notebook-style, top-to-bottom workflow UI on sequential-workflow-designer@0.40.0 + sequential-workflow-designer-react@0.40.0 (MIT, React peer >=18.2.0 — OK with React 19): the user adds prompt / image / video steps as cells in a vertical sequence, fills them in a step editor panel, runs each one through the existing generation pipeline, and the sequence becomes the record of what was done.

User-confirmed decisions:
- Full removal of templates + all 3 formulas, client and server. /templates header button deleted; /plan button stays.
- Manual cells (Jupyter-style): steps are added/run by the user in the notebook; gens from /image and /video panels stay separate.
- Thumbs + editor panel: canvas steps are compact SWD shapes whose icon becomes the output thumbnail; rich form + output gallery live in the side editor panel. (Verified: SWD's iconUrlProvider(componentType, type) does NOT receive the step — per-step thumbnails are done via a small DOM-decoration hook.)

The plan asset stays a singleton (plan/ dir, engine infers type plan): sidecar plan/.plan.json + human-readable plan/index.md. The engine marks the plan asset ready ONLY when index.md exists — every write must write both files.

## Sequencing (child tasks)

1. Deps + spike: install both SWD packages; render a hardcoded 3-step definition in a scratch mount to burn down SWD risks (StrictMode double-mount, dark CSS, stepEditor JSX prop propagation, data-step-id DOM, data-URI icons).
2. Server: plan-notebook.ts, read_plan rewrite, write_plan, rename-all adaptation + server half of the deletion. Independently testable via vitest.
3. Client: client half of the deletion + notebook UI, landing together (PlanNotebook replaces PlanViewer at both mount points in the same change).
4. Gates + cleanup: greps, build/lint/test, headless gen-loop test, manual E2E.

## Risks / confirm at install time

1. iconUrlProvider has no step argument (verified in 0.40.0 typings) → DOM-decoration hook is the plan of record; degrade = static icons only.
2. WrappedDefinition identity rules — single wrapDefinition call, always store the emitted instance (else edit→reload loops).
3. stepEditor JSX element prop propagation; StrictMode double-mount of the imperative canvas; replaceDefinition possibly clearing selection; data-URI SVGs inside SVG <image href> (fallback: files in public/); exact ReactToolboxConfiguration shape — all covered by the spike.
4. rename-all.test.ts may hold formula-shaped plan fixtures — convert while extending.
5. Any future .plan.json writer must also write index.md (engine hardcodes plan readiness on it); writePlanFiles is the only sanctioned writer, rename-all the only other one.


title: extractWaveform maxBuffer overflow: stream PCM with bounded-memory RMS folding

Same 8kHz RMS fidelity (maxDiff 0.03 vs old on a short clip).

# Simplify /notebook arrows: orthogonal trunk edges

## Context

The `/notebook` view (React Flow canvas at `src/components/center-stage/notebook/`) currently renders one `smoothstep` curved SVG edge per connection (source→target pair). With fan-in/fan-out patterns these curves overlap ambiguously. The user provided an explicit design guide: render each **connection group** as one orthogonal **trunk** — branch stubs from member nodes, a horizontal bus, a filled dot (●) at the intentional join, and a single vertical trunk in its own lane. Trunks never merge with unrelated trunks; crossings are fine because dots mark only intentional joins. Hovering a trunk highlights the whole group and dims the rest.

Connections live only as `properties.inputs: string[]` on image/video target steps (general DAG; `first_frame_source` pins one input). Layout is deterministic track math (`model.ts`): rows at `y = 48 + depth*440`, slots at `x = 112 + slot*348`, nodes ≤340 tall → a clear inter-row gap where buses can live. Handles: source = bottom center, target = top center; flow is strictly downward.

## Design

### Grouping rule (deterministic, matches the guide)
- Target step with **≥2 inputs** → **fan-in group** `in:<targetId>` (all its incoming edges). Example: T1 = A2,A3,A4 → B3.
- Remaining edges (targets with exactly 1 input) → **fan-out group** `out:<sourceId>:<targetDepth>` (covers 1→N per row, and 1→1 trivially). Examples: T2 = A7 → B7,B8,B9; T3 = A10 → B10.
- Every edge belongs to exactly one group. Groups of size 1 render a plain elbow with **no dot** (dots mark joins only). No T-labels — nodes already have names.

### Rendering model: one edge per connection, "primary renders the trunk"
Keep one React Flow edge per (source,target) — preserves per-connection select/delete — but with a custom `trunk` edge type instead of `smoothstep`:
- Every member edge renders only its **unique branch stub** via `<BaseEdge>` (keeps `react-flow__edge-path` class → existing prompt/ref/active/muted/running CSS applies to stubs unchanged).
- One deterministic **primary** member (first in `inputs` order for fan-in; first target in sequence order for fan-out) additionally renders the **shared geometry** (bus + trunk + dot) as raw `<path>`/`<circle>` — deliberately *not* `BaseEdge`, so per-edge state CSS can't touch it. This avoids overdraw entirely: no opacity-stacking seams from `opacity: 0.18` muting, no misaligned marching-ants on shared segments, dot and glow render exactly once.

### Geometry (all from live edge-prop coords → drag works for free)
- `busY = targetY - 56 + (staggerIndex - 1) * 10` — sits in the inter-band gap; `staggerIndex ∈ {0,1,2}` assigned per row-gap by enumerating groups sorted by anchor x, so unrelated buses in the same gap are never collinear.
- **Fan-in**: stub `M sourceX sourceY V busY`; shared (primary) `M minX busY H maxX  M targetX busY V targetY` (span = member xs ∪ targetX); dot at `(targetX, busY)`.
- **Fan-out**: stub `M targetX busY V targetY`; shared (primary) `M sourceX sourceY V busY  M minX busY H maxX`; dot at `(sourceX, busY)`.
- Primary reads live sibling handle center-xs via a `useStore` selector (joined-string key so strict equality memoizes; no shallow import).

### Hover
`hoveredGroupId` state in `NotebookCanvas` + `TrunkHoverContext`; `onEdgeMouseEnter/Leave` on `<ReactFlow>` set it from `edge.data.groupId`. Hovered group's `<g>` gets `is-hovered`; a `vc-notebook-trunk-hovering` class on the canvas div dims all non-hovered trunks to 0.2 via CSS. Edge objects never change on hover → `reconcileEdges` identity reuse intact. Clear hover state in `onDelete` (mouseleave doesn't fire when the hovered edge unmounts). Existing selection-route highlighting (`vc-notebook-edge-active/muted`, `vc-notebook-has-route`) is kept, extended with group aggregates.

## Files

### CREATE `src/components/center-stage/notebook/trunk-edges.ts` — pure helpers (unit-testable)
```ts
export const TRUNK_BUS_GAP = 56
export const TRUNK_BUS_STAGGER = 10
export type TrunkGroupKind = 'fan-in' | 'fan-out'
export interface TrunkEdgeData extends Record<string, unknown> {
  kind: 'prompt' | 'ref'; pinned: boolean
  groupId: string; groupKind: TrunkGroupKind; groupSize: number
  isPrimary: boolean; siblingIds: string[]   // fan-in: source ids; fan-out: target ids
  staggerIndex: number
  groupActive: boolean; groupRunning: boolean // aggregates over members
}
export function computeTrunkGroups(definition: NotebookPlanDefinition): ReadonlyMap<string /* edgeId */, GroupAssignment>
export function trunkBusY(targetTopY: number, staggerIndex: number): number
export function trunkStubPath(kind: TrunkGroupKind, p: Coords & { busY: number }): string
export function trunkSharedPath(kind: TrunkGroupKind, p: Coords & { busY: number; siblingXs: number[] }): string
export function trunkDot(kind: TrunkGroupKind, p: { sourceX: number; targetX: number; busY: number; groupSize: number }): { x: number; y: number } | null  // null when groupSize === 1
export function trunkEdgeDataEqual(a?: TrunkEdgeData, b?: TrunkEdgeData): boolean
```
Uses `notebookTrackDepths` / positions from `model.ts` for depth keys and stagger anchors.

### CREATE `src/components/center-stage/notebook/TrunkEdge.tsx`
Memoized edge component + `TrunkHoverContext`. Renders: `<BaseEdge path={stub} interactionWidth={18}/>`; if primary: shared `<path className="vc-trunk-shared …">`, an invisible 18px-wide `react-flow__edge-interaction` path over the shared segments (makes the bus hoverable/clickable), and `<circle className="vc-trunk-dot" r={3.5}>` (plain circle in the edge `<g>` — zoom-scales naturally). Hooks run unconditionally (selector short-circuits for non-primary).

### CREATE `src/components/center-stage/notebook/trunk-edges.test.ts`
Vitest, zero mocks, definitions built with real `model.ts` helpers (`createEmptyDefinition`, `addStep`, `connectSteps`, `snapDefinitionToTracks` — mirror `model.test.ts` style):
- 3→1 ⇒ one `in:` group, size 3, primary = `inputs[0]`; 1→2 same depth ⇒ one `out:` group; mixed membership ⇒ each edge in exactly one group; same source → targets at different depths ⇒ separate `out:` groups; two multi-input targets in one row ⇒ different `staggerIndex`.
- Path-string assertions for stub/shared/busY/dot (incl. dot null at groupSize 1, span includes anchor x outside member range); `trunkEdgeDataEqual` positive/negative (incl. siblingIds reorder).

### MODIFY `src/components/center-stage/notebook/useNotebookFlow.ts`
- `desiredEdges` (lines 168–199): call `computeTrunkGroups(definition)` once; emit `type: 'trunk'`, `animated: false` (RF's default `.animated` dash rule would corrupt the primary's shared path — running visuals move fully to CSS classes), keep the existing className list, extend `data` with the group assignment + `groupActive` (any member in `route.edgeIds`) + `groupRunning` (any member's source/target running).
- `reconcileEdges` (lines 219–232): replace the `data?.pinned` comparison with `trunkEdgeDataEqual(old.data, next.data)`.

### MODIFY `src/components/center-stage/notebook/PlanNotebook.tsx`
- Module-scope `const EDGE_TYPES = { trunk: TrunkEdge }`; pass `edgeTypes={EDGE_TYPES}`.
- `hoveredGroupId` state; wrap `<ReactFlow>` in `TrunkHoverContext.Provider`; `onEdgeMouseEnter/Leave`; append `vc-notebook-trunk-hovering` to the canvas div class (line 192); clear hover in the `onDelete` path.
- Line 236: `connectionLineType={ConnectionLineType.Step}` for an orthogonal drag preview.

### MODIFY `src/components/center-stage/notebook/notebook.css`
- Scope muting to the path (line 1399–1401): `.vc-notebook-edge-muted .react-flow__edge-path { opacity: 0.18 }` — a muted primary must not dim the shared trunk.
- New rules near 1388–1407: `.vc-trunk-shared` base (stroke `rgb(74 222 128 / 0.62)`, width 1.5, subtle drop-shadow) with `.is-active` (bright, 2.25) and `.is-running` (dasharray 7 5 + `vc-notebook-signal`); `.vc-trunk-dot` fill `rgb(110 231 183)`; route dimming `.vc-notebook-has-route .vc-trunk-shared:not(.is-active) { opacity: 0.18 }` (same for dot); hover `.vc-notebook-trunk-hovering .vc-trunk:not(.is-hovered) { opacity: 0.2 }` and bright stroke on hovered group's stub + shared paths; `.selected` edge rule extended to `.vc-trunk-shared`.
- Add `.vc-trunk-shared.is-running` to the reduced-motion block (~line 1647).

### OPTIONAL `src/components/center-stage/notebook/NotebookStageBoard.tsx` (lines 124–127)
Replace the bezier drop-preview with the matching orthogonal path `M sourceX sourceY V (targetY-56) H targetX V targetY`. Do last.

## Edge cases / known behavior
- Mid-drag: fan-out members can transiently disagree on busY until drop resnaps the definition; no worse than today's smoothstep, NaN-free.
- Deleting the primary edge: next `desiredEdges` pass re-elects a primary automatically (rebuilt from definition).
- Clicking the shared bus selects/deletes the primary member's connection only — document as known (same topmost-wins class of surprise as today).
- Cross-row stubs pass over intermediate node faces (edges z-index 3 > nodes 1) — identical to current smoothstep behavior; no mitigation.
- Two different groups leaving one source handle share a vertical drop until their staggered busYs — subtle alpha brightening, accepted (fallback: opaque base stroke).
- `data.pinned` currently has no visual (zero CSS refs) — carried through unchanged; optional later polish: hollow ring at the pinned stub's junction.

## Implementation sequencing (for whoever executes the bead)
1. `trunk-edges.ts` + `trunk-edges.test.ts` → `npm test` green.
2. `TrunkEdge.tsx` + hover context.
3. Wire `useNotebookFlow.ts`, then `PlanNotebook.tsx`, then `notebook.css`.
4. Optional stage-board preview path.
5. Verification below.

## Verification
- `npm test` (new trunk-edges tests + existing suites) and `tsc -b` via `npm run build`; `npm run lint`.
- Manual in dev app (`npm run dev`, open `/notebook`):
  1. Fan-in (2 prompts + 1 asset → image): one bus in the row gap, three stubs, dot above the target, single trunk into its top.
  2. Fan-out (image → two videos): trunk drop, dot at bar, two branch drops; a 1:1 pair shows a plain elbow, no dot.
  3. Drag a fan-in source sideways — stub + bus extent follow live; drop resnaps.
  4. Hover bus and each stub — whole group brightens, others dim to 0.2; leave restores; deleting hovered edge clears dimming.
  5. Select target — whole trunk active; select one source — its stub + trunk bright, sibling stubs muted with no seams.
  6. Running: source running → ants on its stub only; target running → one clean dashed trunk.
  7. Click stub → Backspace deletes that connection; click bus → deletes primary connection; undo restores.
  8. Drag-from-handle preview is orthogonal; adjacent multi-input targets get different bus heights.
  9. Zoom 0.25–1.5 crisp; reduced-motion disables ants.

# Notebook: drop-anywhere stages, visible gen stacks, add-stage

## Context

From the annotated screenshot of `/notebook`, three asks:

1. **Drop assets at any stage** — sidebar assets currently always land in Stage 01 no matter where they're dropped.
2. **Stack gens visibly, all gens** — a gen cell shows only its latest generation; the user wants every generation visible. (Decision: clicking an older gen **promotes** it to the active output used downstream; undo must work.)
3. **Add more stages** — there's always exactly one trailing empty stage, and nothing can be placed in a stage unless connection topology puts it there. (Decision: also allow dragging **existing** cells vertically to re-stage them.)

**Root cause for 1 & 3:** a cell's stage is a *derived* graph depth (`notebookTrackDepths` in `src/components/center-stage/notebook/model.ts:161` — 0 if no inputs, else max(parents)+1), and every mutation runs `snapDefinitionToTracks`, forcing y from depth. Assets have no inputs → always depth 0.

**Feature 2 is presentation-only:** `asset_ids` already appends every run (`appendRunAsset`, `model.ts:479`); all readers use `latestAssetId` = `asset_ids.at(-1)` (`model.ts:423`), so "last element = active output" is already the invariant everywhere (downstream slugs, run status, sidebar, markdown mirror). Promotion = move clicked id to the end; every reader follows automatically.

**No server changes:** step and definition `properties` are free-form `z.record` (`server/src/plan-notebook.ts:26-36`), so new keys (`depth`, `stage_count`) pass validation as-is.

All files below are under `src/components/center-stage/notebook/` unless noted.

## Design decisions

- **Persisted depth override**: new step property `depth?: number`. Effective depth = `max(storedDepth ?? 0, computedFromParents)`. Since computed depth uses parents' *effective* depths, "child never above parent+1" is enforced automatically — no write-time clamping.
- Store the override only when `requested > computedFromParents`; delete the key otherwise (dragging a cell back up "releases" it).
- **Disconnect/remove bake depth**: when a step loses an input, write its prior effective depth into `depth` so it doesn't jump back to Stage 01. Rule: topology can push cells down; nothing moves a cell up implicitly (only drag / explicit action).
- **Stage count**: definition-level `properties.stage_count?: number` as a minimum row count; `rowCount = max(maxDepth + 2, stage_count)`.
- Prompts lose their forced-depth-0 special case in drag-drop (they can sit in any stage); toolbox *click* still appends at Stage 01.
- **Promote callback** reaches `GenNode` through `NotebookNodeData` with a ref-stabilized callback (matches existing `callToolRef`/`definitionRef` patterns); no context provider.
- Pending/errored gens appear in the stack (status-styled) and are promotable — consistent with today's model where a fresh (pending) run is immediately the active output.
- Auto-arrange keeps overrides and `stage_count`; it only tidies x-order.

## Phase 0 — Model foundation (`model.ts`)

New pure helpers (flat, explicit types):

- `storedStepDepth(step): number | null` — `properties.depth` if integer > 0, else null.
- `notebookStageCount(definition): number` — `properties.stage_count` if integer ≥ 1, else 1.
- `notebookBoardLastRow(definition, depths?): number` — `max(maxEffectiveDepth + 1, stageCount - 1)`; the interaction clamp for drops/drags.
- `setStepDepthOverride(definition, stepId, depth: number | null)` — writes/deletes the key; **identity-return when unchanged** (mirror `setFirstFrameSource`, `model.ts:680`) so pure-x reorders don't pollute history.

Modify:

- `notebookTrackDepths` (161): `return max(storedStepDepth(step) ?? 0, computed)`.
- `stageBoardMetrics` (371): third param `stageCount = 1`; `rowCount = max(maxDepth + 2, stageCount)`. Update caller `notebookInitialViewport` (403).
- `disconnectSteps` (663) / `removeSteps` (752): using pre-mutation depths, bake `depth: priorEffectiveDepth` (when > 0) into each step that loses an input.

## Phase 1 — "+ Add stage" (`NotebookStageBoard.tsx`, `PlanNotebook.tsx`, `notebook.css`)

- `NotebookStageBoard`: new prop `onAddStage`; pass `notebookStageCount(definition)` into `stageBoardMetrics`. Render a `+ Add stage NN` button **as a sibling of** `.vc-notebook-stage-board` inside the same `ViewportPortal` (the board div is `aria-hidden` with `pointer-events: none`, `notebook.css:973`), positioned just below the last band, with `pointer-events: auto` and React Flow's `nopan` class so clicks don't pan.
- `PlanNotebook`: `handleAddStage` commits `{ ...current, properties: { ...current.properties, stage_count: currentRowCount + 1 } }`; thread through `NotebookCanvasProps`. Undo via history; no auto-shrink on delete (rowCount already shrinks when depth dominates).
- CSS: `.vc-notebook-add-stage` — dashed ghost-band button styled like a stage row.

## Phase 2 — Drops at any stage (`model.ts`, `PlanNotebook.tsx`, `NotebookStageBoard.tsx`, `notebook.css`)

- `notebookDropTarget` (327): remove prompt depth-0 forcing; clamp `requestedDepth` to `[0, notebookBoardLastRow]`; keep parent auto-detect, but when no unambiguous parent, keep `requestedDepth` unlinked instead of falling back to 0.
- New `notebookAssetDropTarget(definition, pointer): { position, depth, slot, connectTargetId }` — pure model helper replacing the `flow.nodes` bbox scan in `onDrop` (`PlanNotebook.tsx:140-148`); hit-tests gen steps via `layout.positions` + `notebookNodeSizes`. Hit → `depth = max(0, genDepth - 1)`, `connectTargetId = gen.id`; miss → depth from pointer y.
- `addStep` (718) / `addAssetStep` (731): optional `depth?` param → writes the override when > 0. Asset slug-reuse path unchanged (re-drop doesn't re-stage an existing shared asset cell).
- `handleAddAsset` (`PlanNotebook.tsx:391`): use `notebookAssetDropTarget`, pass real drop position + depth, connect when `connectTargetId`. `handleAddStep`: pass `depth` only when unlinked (`parentId === null`).
- **Asset drop preview**: during `onDragOver`, sniff `event.dataTransfer.types` for the `application/x-videocity-asset-(image|video|audio)` marker (set by `src/components/sidebar/cards/CardShell.tsx:122`; data itself is unreadable until drop) → show ghost card. Extend `NotebookDropPreview.type` with `'asset'` + optional `assetKind`; icon per kind; invert the dashed link (asset feeds *into* the gen: preview-bottom → gen-top); labels `Connect input` / `Add asset`. Add `onDragLeave` clearing the preview only when the pointer truly leaves the canvas (`!currentTarget.contains(relatedTarget)`). CSS: `.vc-notebook-drop-card-asset`.

## Phase 3 — Drag existing cells between stages (`model.ts`, `useNotebookFlow.ts`)

- New `constrainTrackDragPosition(definition, layout, stepId, position): StepPosition` — x via existing `quantizedTrackX`; y quantized to rows and clamped to `[maxParentDepth + 1 (or 0), notebookBoardLastRow]` for live row-snapping feedback.
- `useNotebookFlow.onNodesChange` (247-262): replace the `y: locked.y` lock with `constrainTrackDragPosition`.
- Rewrite `reorderStepsOnTracks` (271): per move, compute requested row from final y → `setStepDepthOverride(staged, id, requested > parentsDepth ? requested : null)`; recompute `notebookTrackDepths(staged)` and rebuild rows via `orderedStepsByDepth` of the staged definition (so descendants pushed down regroup correctly); group moves by **new effective depth**; reuse the existing min-slot splice; finish with `trackLayoutFromRows` + `moveSteps`.
- Multi-select drags clamp per-node against pre-move parent depths (child may drift to `parentNew + 1`; acceptable, asserted in tests).

## Phase 4 — Visible gen stack + promote (`model.ts`, `nodes/nodeTypes.ts`, `useNotebookFlow.ts`, `nodes/GenNode.tsx`, `PlanNotebook.tsx`, `notebook.css`)

- Model: `GenRunOutput { assetId, thumbnailSrc, status: 'ready'|'pending'|'error'|'missing', active }`; `stepRunOutputs(step, mediaItems): GenRunOutput[]` (chronological, status mapping mirrors `stepRunStatus`, `[]` for non-gen); `promoteRunAsset(definition, stepId, assetId)` — moves id to end of `asset_ids`; identity-return when absent/already last (history no-ops).
- `NotebookNodeData` gains `outputs: GenRunOutput[]` and `onPromoteAsset: (stepId, assetId) => void`; add both to `dataEqual` (`useNotebookFlow.ts:45`) with an `outputsEqual` mirroring `mediaInputsEqual`.
- `useNotebookFlow`: accept `onPromoteAsset` option, ref-stabilize it, thread into `nodeData` alongside `outputs: stepRunOutputs(...)`.
- `GenNode`: when `outputs.length > 1`, render `.vc-node-output-strip nodrag` of `<button>` thumbs below the hero — active one ringed, pending spinner, error icon; `onClick` stops propagation and calls `onPromoteAsset` unless already active. Hero stays `latestAssetId` (unchanged).
- `PlanNotebook`: `handlePromoteAsset` → `commit(promoteRunAsset(...))`; no snap needed (no topology change).
- CSS near the input-strip block (~210-256): `.vc-node-output-strip` (bottom-anchored above `.vc-node-meta`, flex-end so newest stays visible, **`pointer-events: auto`** — do not copy the input strip's `none`), `.vc-node-output-thumb` overlapping-thumb recipe + hover lift, `is-active` / `is-pending` / `is-error` / `is-missing` states.

Documented tradeoff: promotion reorders `asset_ids`, so strict chronology is lost after a promote; a completing run always appends and reclaims "active" (newest-wins, matching today).

## Phase 5 — Tests

`model.test.ts`:
- **Rewrite** `'locks vertical movement…'` (line 318 — codifies the removed y-lock): drag to `y: 9999` → clamped to last row + `depth` stored; drag back up → key deleted.
- **Update** `'selects a smart parent…'` (341): ambiguous drop now `{ parentId: null, depth: requested }`; prompt deep-drop no longer forced to 0.
- **New**: depth override honored / max(stored, computed) / cycle-safe; disconnect & remove bake depth; `notebookDropTarget` clamps to board last row incl. `stage_count`; `notebookAssetDropTarget` gen-hit (incl. depth-0 gen push-down case) and empty-band cases; `addAssetStep` depth + slug-reuse ignores depth; `reorderStepsOnTracks` cross-row moves, descendant regrouping, pure-x no-churn; `stageBoardMetrics` with stageCount; `notebookStageCount` parsing; `promoteRunAsset` reorder/identity + `latestAssetId`/`resolveEffectiveValues` follow; `stepRunOutputs` status mapping + active flag.

`notebook-gen-ui.test.ts` (source-assertion style): GenNode has `vc-node-output-strip`/`nodrag`/`onPromoteAsset`; StageBoard has `vc-notebook-add-stage`/`nopan`; PlanNotebook has the asset-marker sniff and `onAddStage`; css has new classes. `useNotebookRun.test.ts` unchanged (append semantics untouched).

## Verification

- `npm run test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build` (tsc -b).
- In-app (`npm run dev`, open a project → `/notebook`):
  1. Drag sidebar asset over Stage 03 → ghost in that row; drop → unconnected asset cell in Stage 03; Cmd+Z removes.
  2. Drop asset onto a Stage-02 gen → gen highlights, ghost sits row above with link pointing into the gen; connected, gen doesn't move rows.
  3. "+ Add stage" (test at multiple zoom levels) → new empty band; drop a toolbox cell in it unlinked; reload → persists; `plan/.plan.json` has `stage_count`.
  4. Drag an existing cell vertically → live row snapping, can't cross above parent+1; disconnect its edge → stays put (baked depth).
  5. Generate twice → two thumbs, newest ringed active; click older → hero swaps, downstream input strip + sidebar slug follow, `plan/index.md` Produces reorders; Cmd+Z reverts; new run reclaims active.
  6. Auto-arrange → overrides + stage_count survive.

design:
# Plan Notebook round 3 — React Flow node graph: connection-driven refs, no node titles, plain sidebar

## Context

Rounds 1–2 (branch `plan-notebook-game-cards`) built the game-style card canvas on `sequential-workflow-designer` (SWD). The user's round-3 annotated screenshot asks for:

1. **"refs are chosen by connect nodes (can have multiple inputs)"** — refs come from graph connections, not the sidebar dropzone. SWD is strictly a linear sequence (no joins, no multi-input) — this forces replacing the canvas engine with a true node graph: **`@xyflow/react` 12.11.2** (verified: peer `react >=17`; transitive `zustand@4.5.7` peer `react >=16.8`; the React-19 issue xyflow/xyflow#5229 is closed; ~50 kB min+gz, offset by removing both SWD packages).
2. **"no node titles"** — remove the CELL NAME input and name display from cards. `name` stays in the data (server schema requires it; seeded "Prompt"/"Image"/"Video"/"Asset") but is never shown or edited.
3. **"forget slash command ui, just use normal form elements to save vertical space"** — replace GenSection `/prompt` `/refs` `/options` framing and the CommandDropdown model picker with compact plain form rows.

User confirmed (AskUserQuestion): legacy dropzone-set refs are **converted to asset nodes + edges** on load; a connected Prompt node's text **replaces** the cell's local prompt (read-only "linked" display); the **/generate game button stays** (with its cost slot).

**Why this is tractable with zero persistence redesign**: server `planStepSchema`/`planDefinitionSchema` (server/src/plan-notebook.ts:26-50) are `.strict()` on step/plan keys but `properties` is free-form `z.record(z.unknown())` — so `properties.position`, `properties.inputs`, `properties.first_frame_source`, `properties.slug` round-trip byte-for-byte today. Outputs and ref inputs share one namespace: gen tools return bare asset ids (`img-…`), ref fields accept the same ids with optional `@` (resolvers strip it) — node A's output feeds node B's ref with **no format conversion**. The real gate is readiness: server resolvers fail if the upstream media file doesn't exist yet, so Run is gated client-side on upstream `stepRunStatus === 'ready'`.

## Semantics (decided)

- **Node types**: `prompt` | `image` | `video` | `asset` (new). Asset node = pointer to an existing project asset (`properties.slug: '@img-…'`), created by dragging an asset from the app sidebar onto the canvas. Toolbox keeps only Prompt/Image/Video.
- **Edges** = per-gen-step `properties.inputs: string[]` (ordered upstream step ids). ONE target handle (top) on gen nodes accepting multiple edges; one source handle (bottom) on every node (prompt/asset nodes have no target handle → gen→prompt cycles unrepresentable in UI). Vertical flow, matching rounds 1–2.
- **Connection-owned params**: `CONNECTION_OWNED_PARAMS = ['image_slugs', 'video_slug', 'first_frame_slug']` — the only keys the old notebook UI ever wrote. All other `isAssetField` params (last_frame_slug, elements, audio…) stop being excluded from the options list and render as plain mono `DynamicField` text inputs accepting `@slug`. (Per-chip slot re-assignment is a documented follow-up, not this round.)
- **Resolution at run/estimate time** (`resolveEffectiveValues`): base = step values minus connection-owned params; walk `inputs` in order — prompt source → collect text, joined `\n\n`, **replaces** `values.prompt`; asset source → its slug; gen source → `@${latestAssetId(source)}` (null → skip + warning). `first_frame_source` pin routes that ref to `first_frame_slug` when the schema has it; the rest route via `routeDrop(kind, deriveStripSlots(option))` but **write by the target param's schema type**: `array` → append (dedupe, slot `max` overflow → warning), `string` → set (second writer → warning). Mode inference (`inferModeKey`) then runs on the resolved record, so connecting a first-frame ref flips i2v tool/price exactly like Run.
- **Run gating**: gen sources must be `ready`, prompt sources non-empty, asset sources present+ready — else Run disabled with reasons.
- **Validity**: gen cell invalid when no local prompt AND no prompt input; prompt node invalid when text empty. Red-pulse card state, replaces the SWD validator.
- **Characters** stay sidebar-picked values (`character_refs` via CharacterPickerPopover) — they're Google Flow entities, not assets.

## Implementation (phased; each phase ends `npm run lint && npx tsc -b && npm run test` green)

### Phase 1 — Server (ship first: old server rejects `'asset'` steps)
`server/src/plan-notebook.ts`: add `"asset"` to the `type` enum (line 29) + `PlanStep` interface; `renderPlanMarkdown` gains `renderAssetMarkdown` (`- **Asset:** @img-…`) and an `- **Inputs:** …` line in `renderGenerationMarkdown` from `properties.inputs`. Extend `server/src/tools/write-plan.test.ts` + `read-plan.test.ts` (asset step + inputs fixture round-trip, new markdown lines) and `rename-all.test.ts` (asset step `properties.slug` gets rewritten — `rewriteDeep` exact-matches `@`-prefixed ids, already works; step ids in `inputs` never collide with asset ids).

### Phase 2 — Model layer (same branch as phase 3; types ripple)
- `types.ts`: drop the SWD import; define `NotebookPlanStep`/`NotebookPlanDefinition` locally (same shape, `componentType: 'task'` kept); `NotebookStepType` + `'asset'`.
- `model.ts` — new pure functions (★ = unit-tested in `model.test.ts`):
  - `stepPosition(step)`, `stepInputs(step)`, `assetSlugKind(slug)` (img-/vid-/aud-/char- prefix).
  - ★ `normalizeDefinition(def) → {definition, changed}` — idempotent: (a) missing positions → vertical column (per-type card height + 48 gap, **integers** — floats would churn the JSON dirty-check + git sidecar forever); (b) migrate each connection-owned slug: if it equals an earlier gen step's `latestAssetId` → edge from that step; else find-or-create asset step (deterministic id `asset-<bare-slug>`, deduped by slug, placed left of first consumer), append to `inputs`, `first_frame_slug` source also sets `first_frame_source`; strip migrated keys from `values`. `changed === false` ⇒ same object identity (no autosave).
  - ★ `wouldCreateCycle(def, sourceId, targetId)` (DFS over `stepInputs`), ★ `canConnect` (target is gen; no self/dupe/cycle), ★ `connectSteps` (no-op same-identity when invalid), ★ `disconnectSteps` (also clears matching `first_frame_source`), ★ `setFirstFrameSource`.
  - ★ `moveSteps(def, moves[])` (Math.round), ★ `addStep(def, seed, position)` (crypto.randomUUID), ★ `addAssetStep(def, slug, position)` (reuses existing node by slug), ★ `removeSteps(def, ids[])` (prunes `inputs` + `first_frame_source` everywhere), `updateStepProperties(def, id, patch)`.
  - ★ `resolveEffectiveValues(def, step, option) → {values, warnings, promptFromInputs}` (rules above), ★ `stepInputReadiness(def, step, mediaItems) → {ready, reasons}`, ★ `stepInvalidReason(def, step)`, `graphLayoutBounds(def)`.
  - Delete `nearestPromptAbove` (+ its test). Keep `latestAssetId`/`appendRunAsset`/`stepRunStatus` unchanged.
- `useNotebookPlan.ts`: replace `wrapDefinition`/`WrappedDefinition` with plain definition state → `{definition, setDefinition, saveState, error, legacy, flush}`; run `normalizeDefinition` after load, `changed` → set + one-time `scheduleSave`. Autosave loop, dirty-check, `pendingPlanWrites` remount guard, failed-load semantics stay byte-identical.
- NEW `useDefinitionHistory.ts`: snapshot stack (cap 50), `commit(next, coalesceKey?)` (500 ms coalesce for text edits, e.g. `text:<stepId>:prompt`), undo/redo + `canUndo`/`canRedo`, document-level Cmd/Ctrl+Z / Shift+Cmd+Z with input/textarea/contentEditable target guard, redo cleared on commit, baseline reset on load. **Every mutation funnels through `commit`** (connect/disconnect/move/add/remove/updateStep/appendRunAsset).
- `useNotebookRun.ts`: unchanged logic; `replaceDefinition` prop becomes `(next, stepId) => {history.commit(next); setSelectedStepId(stepId)}`. Callers pass **resolved** values.
- `useCanvasCostEstimates.ts`: `deriveStepEstimateCall(definition, step, preview, projectSlug)` — input = `prefilled_values ⊕ resolveEffectiveValues(...).values`; skip `'asset'` steps like `'prompt'`. Update tests; add a case where a connected first-frame input flips the inferred mode/tool name.

### Phase 3 — Canvas swap
- `npm i @xyflow/react` (then `npm ls zustand use-sync-external-store` — expect zustand ≥4.5.6, uSES ≥1.4.0); remove both `sequential-workflow-designer*` deps.
- NEW `useNotebookFlow.ts` — the state-sync layer. **Local `Node[]`/`Edge[]` state + definition→local reconciler effect, NOT pure useMemo** (controlled RF only moves nodes if the prop carries in-flight drag positions; memo-derived nodes freeze dragging). Reconciler on `[definition, mediaItems, stepCosts, runningStepIds, errors]`: build desired node per step; keep `old.position` while `old.dragging`; if data shallow-equal + position equal → **return the old node object** (identity-stable ⇒ `memo` nodes skip re-renders on sidebar keystrokes/poll ticks); else spread old (preserves `selected`/`dragging`/`measured`). Every node carries explicit `width`/`height` constants (deterministic cards → edges anchor on first paint, no measurement churn). Edges same treatment (`id: `${source}->${target}``, `data: {kind: 'prompt'|'ref', pinned}` for amber-vs-emerald styling + pin badge; selection preserved by spread). `onNodesChange`/`onEdgesChange` = applyNodeChanges/applyEdgeChanges into local state only. Mutations read the definition via a ref so callbacks stay identity-stable.
- `PlanNotebook.tsx` rewrite: header/banners unchanged; body = flex row of `<ReactFlowProvider><NotebookCanvas/></ReactFlowProvider>` + `<NotebookSidebar/>` (plain `<aside>`, ~420px, collapsible). RF props: `nodeTypes={NODE_TYPES}` (module constant — RF warns on unstable identity), `onConnect` → `connectSteps`, `isValidConnection` → `canConnect`, **`onDelete({nodes, edges})`** → single `removeSteps`/`disconnectSteps` commit (avoids the onNodesDelete+onEdgesDelete double-commit), `onNodeDragStop` → one `moveSteps` commit for all dragged nodes, `onSelectionChange` → lift exactly-one-selected id, `onInit` → top-anchored viewport (bbox via `graphLayoutBounds` → center x, y=40, zoom clamp [0.5, 1]), `deleteKeyCode={['Backspace','Delete']}` (RF's isInputDOMNode guard keeps typing safe), `minZoom={0.25} maxZoom={1.5}`, `colorMode="dark"`, `proOptions={{hideAttribution: true}}` (MIT-permitted config; comment noting xyflow's subscribe ask). Children: `<Background variant="dots" gap={40}/>`, `<Controls showInteractive={false}>` + two `ControlButton`s for undo/redo, `<NotebookToolbox/>`.
- NEW `nodes/` — `nodeTypes.ts` (data interfaces `[key: string]: unknown`-compatible; `NODE_TYPES = {prompt, image: GenNode, video: GenNode, asset}`; size constants), `GenNode.tsx` (memo; 200px HTML/Tailwind port of the game card: hero thumb/icon, status ring running/error/ready, footer = truncated mono **model key** + cost badge — no name; invalid red pulse; Handle target top + source bottom), `PromptNode.tsx` (amber, `line-clamp-2` excerpt — CSS replaces the SVG word-wrap; source handle only), `AssetNode.tsx` (thumb + slug caption, red tint when missing; source handle only). Display state rides in `node.data` (identity-stabilized by the reconciler) — no per-node context.
- NEW `NotebookToolbox.tsx`: floating top-left panel (round-1 styling), three seeds with lucide icons; `dataTransfer.setData('application/x-videocity-notebook-step', type)`; click = add below `graphLayoutBounds.maxY + 48`.
- Canvas drops (wrapper div `onDragOver`/`onDrop`): toolbox mime → `addStep` at `screenToFlowPosition`; asset payload (parse like AssetDropSlot.tsx:87-106; accept image/video/audio, ignore character) → if drop point hits a gen node (`getIntersectingNodes`) → `addAssetStep` offset left + `connectSteps` in ONE commit; else `addAssetStep` at point.

### Phase 4 — Sidebar (`NotebookStepEditor.tsx` → `NotebookSidebar.tsx`)
Same-root React now: **delete editorBridge**; everything arrives as ordinary props (`definition`, `selectedStepId`, `mediaItems`, `runningStepIds`, `errors`, `mcpState`, `updateStep`, connect/disconnect/pin callbacks, `onRun`, `onOpenAsset`). Branches:
1. **No selection** → plan-title panel (absorbs NotebookRootEditor: title input bound to `definition.properties.title` + hint).
2. **Prompt step** → type badge + textarea. No CELL NAME.
3. **Asset step** → thumb, slug, kind, Open-asset button, "used by N cells", missing warning.
4. **Gen step** — plain stacked form, sections headed by the existing `.vc-notebook-editor label` idiom (mono uppercase emerald):
   - MODEL: plain `<select class="vc-notebook-select">`, options = model×provider cross-product ported from ModelSelector.tsx:64-89 (`modelKey::providerKey` values); onChange → `updateStep` model/provider + `preview.selectModel`.
   - PROMPT: `RichPromptField` directly (props cloned from PromptSection.tsx:214-238, no GenSection frame; `usePromptHistory` kept via keyboard nav only). When `promptFromInputs !== null` → read-only excerpt block "PROMPT — FROM CONNECTED PROMPT NODE" + source chip; local field hidden (typing into an ignored field is the failure mode to avoid).
   - INPUTS (replaces MediaStrip/refs): compact chip list per `stepInputs` entry — 24px thumb/icon, label (excerpt / slug / model+latest id), routed-param tag, disconnect ✕, and a Pin toggle on image-kind chips only when `'first_frame_slug' in option.schema.properties` → `setFirstFrameSource`. Below: resolver `warnings` + readiness `reasons`. Empty state: "Connect nodes on the canvas to add inputs."
   - OPTIONS: `DynamicField` flex-wrap unchanged; exclusion filter now = `project_slug`, `prompt`, `character_refs`, `CONNECTION_OWNED_PARAMS` (other asset params intentionally included as plain `@slug` inputs).
   - CHARACTERS: CharacterPickerPopover as-is.
   - RunStatus, error, **GenerateCommandButton (game style kept)** — disabled also when `!stepInputReadiness().ready` (reasons in tooltip); `onRun(step, option, provider, prefills ⊕ resolved.values)`; `useEstimateCost` fed resolved values.
   - OutputGallery unchanged.
Removed: CELL NAME inputs, `copyPromptAbove` + button, `previousOutputs` strip, GenSection/PromptSection/MediaStrip/ModelProviderSelector usage (components survive — GenPreviewPanel et al. verified consumers).

### Phase 5 — Migration + walkthrough polish
Wire `normalizeDefinition` on load (phase 2 code, verified against real data here); test migration against a verbatim copy of `projects/notebook-e2e/plan/.plan.json` + the richer write-plan test fixture (idempotence, slug dedupe, output-slug→gen-edge preference, values stripped, unchanged-def identity).

### Phase 6 — Cleanup
Delete: `designerExtensions.ts`, `editorBridge.ts`, `useCanvasStepDecorations.ts`, `icons.ts`, `NotebookRootEditor.tsx`; SWD packages + CSS imports; notebook.css `.sqd-*` rules (~69 selectors incl. body-mounted ghost/context-menu) + `vc-notebook-copy-prompt`/`vc-notebook-prior-output`; MediaStrip `size="large"` branch + StripChip large path (notebook was sole consumer); AssetDropSlot keeps `'plan'` variant only if still referenced, else revert. Optional: `React.lazy` the PlanNotebook import in CenterStage.tsx:12 (own chunk for the graph lib). Run `npx knip` if available to catch stragglers.

## CSS / theming
Import `@xyflow/react/dist/style.css`; theme under `.vc-notebook` via v12 `--xy-*` CSS variables (sanctioned override path, no specificity fights): `--xy-background-color: transparent`, dots `rgb(52 211 153 / 0.14)`, `--xy-edge-stroke*` emerald (amber for `data.kind === 'prompt'` edges via class), `--xy-handle-*`, `--xy-controls-button-*` black/emerald. Port the `.sqd-theme-dark` card palette to `.vc-node-*` classes (per-type strokes amber/cyan/violet + emerald asset, selected glow from RF's `selected` prop, `vc-notebook-pulse` reused for running). New: `.vc-notebook-select`, input-chip, toolbox blocks.

## Risks
- **Migration corrupting plans**: normalizeDefinition is pure + fixture-tested; `useNotebookPlan`'s failed-load guard already prevents clobbering on read errors.
- **Undo × autosave**: undo re-enters `setDefinition`; JSON dirty-check dedupes. Undoing a run-append forgets the record (asset survives) — same as SWD undo, documented.
- **Server/client order**: server enum ships first or `write_plan` hard-rejects asset steps.
- **erasableSyntaxOnly**: no constructor parameter properties in any new class (none planned — all hooks/functions).
- Estimate volume unchanged: per settled change, one batched `estimate_cost` of cache-missing steps.

## Verification
1. `npm run lint`, `npx tsc -b`, `npm run test`, `npx vite build` after each phase.
2. Manual (dev servers + Chrome MCP, project `notebook-e2e`): open plan → one-time migration autosave; `.plan.json` gains positions/inputs only, `index.md` stable. Drag asset from sidebar → asset node; drop onto an Image cell → node + edge in one gesture; Inputs chip appears; cost label updates (mode flip visible on a first-frame pin). Connect Prompt → Image: sidebar prompt goes read-only "linked"; edit the prompt node → linked text updates live. Run Image → thumb lands on card; connect Image → Video: Run gated until image ready, then video runs with `@img-…` resolved. Delete a node → inputs pruned everywhere. Cmd+Z ladder incl. positions and connects. Reload → everything persists; no play/stop, flow top-anchored, no node titles anywhere. `rename all` → asset-node slugs follow.
3. File a `bd` issue for the refactor at implementation start; close at session end per repo protocol.

title: char_swap /plan: source frames stick on 'no source frame' (write-order race)
description: SOURCE FIRST/LAST nodes and the swap node's Image 1 thumb render 'no source frame' even though the JPEGs exist on disk and the server returns 200. Root cause: the plan_visualization job writes .plan.json WITH scenes (server/src/jobs/plan-visualization.ts) BEFORE extracting the per-scene source-frame JPEGs. The client's scene-arrival poll (PlanFlowStack.tsx) renders the source/swap nodes the instant the sidecar reports scenes, so the 404s during the gap. SourceFrameNode then sticks: it only retries when cacheBust changes, but cacheBust is the stable scene start-end, so it never recovers even after the file lands. Fix: (1) job extracts source frames BEFORE writing .plan.json (best-effort: a frame failure logs + degrades that one frame instead of aborting the plan) so 'scenes present implies frames on disk'; (2) SourceFrameNode does a bounded auto-retry (6x/1.5s) keyed on src so a transient miss self-heals.

title: char_swap analysis: single-shot + talking/listening awareness
description: The plan analysis (SYSTEM_PROMPT_PLAN in server/src/tools/plan-visualization.ts) always describes two-shots with both characters talking. Two recurring failures reported from /plan: (1) it fails to recognize the first frame is a non-talking/listening reaction beat; (2) when the source cuts to single shots (shot/reverse-shot) where only one character is on screen and talking, it still forces both characters into the prose. title: Scope rewrite_prompt previous-error auto-lookup beyond prompt text
description:
Review finding (verified CONFIRMED behavior) from the vc-za65 implementation review.

`findPreviousErrorForPrompt` (server/src/tools/rewrite-prompt.ts) matches `fs.generationErrors` rows by normalized prompt text ONLY — no model/category/provider scoping and no recency cutoff, because `GenerationError` (videocity-engine) carries no taskType/model field. Consequence: an IMAGE rewrite whose prompt text happens to equal a failed VIDEO generation prompt silently adapts around the unrelated (possibly stale) video failure, and vice versa.

Options (pick when this actually bites):
- Persist taskType/model into the GenerationError row (engine change: FailureInfo already flows through task-failure.ts which knows taskType) and filter the lookup by category.
- Or gate the auto-lookup to video/provider-docs rewrites only.
- Or add a failedAt recency window (e.g. ignore errors older than N days).
Low practical risk today (exact prompt collision across categories is rare); filed for when generation volume makes it likely.
close_reason: All findings addressed. See individual close details below.
